summary: Documentation deliverables written from the code, not from the design documents. MODEL_ARCHITECTURE.md gives the as-built model with file:function citations, parameter counts measured by building the integrated agent on CPU, the data flow of one decision, and the design differences. MATH_NOTES.md gives the mathematics as implemented, with the code location of each equation, five formulas re-evaluated numerically, and the numerical caveats with their state at HEAD. OPERATOR_RESOURCES.md lists everything the runtime refuses to start or act without, from the preflight / doctor / task-loader code, with the offline preflight of both Discord tasks executed. REPRODUCE.md has dependencies and commands in one place: 83 commands checked (59 with --help, 24 executed offline). KNOWN_FAILURES.md is an append-only register of deployment blockers, negative results and open defects with evidence paths. No code was edited.
